tests: R16: 503 three times then 200 answers the bytes; 503 for the whole bound throws SourceUnavailable naming what; a 404 throws as a 404; a changed byte throws the integrity error
R17: a signed fleet installs every member, container members first, and answers {done, left, imageLags, completed, containers}
R17: each failing condition installs none and says which; the install is not failed over it
R17: an unknown part type leaves that member out alone; a failing member degrades alone and is named; a fleet statement with a member dropped does not verify
R17: installFleet throws only for an approveAgain or a lasting error
R18: after loadFleet the result holds no Uint8Array, ArrayBuffer or Blob of more than 1 KB anywhere in its graph, and nothing was created
R18: the source is asked twice for each bundle and each non-description part and once for each description; the second read is the one just before that member's upload
R18 control: a bundle that changes between the two reads leaves that member out (failed its integrity check) and uploads nothing of it while the others install
R18 control: a source that fails at the second read leaves that member out, named, and installFleet throws nothing; one that fails at the first still throws SourceUnavailable with nothing created
R18: a part that cannot be completed at the first read ends the run; the ocr part is read twice and a changed part is left out like a bundle
R19: a member added gives one re-upload bound to all; none added and no hosts, none; hosts alone give one upload carrying OWN_HOSTS; a refused re-upload is named and the members stay
R20: a release whose container descriptors name ghcr.io images installs every other member and leaves both out as 'out', never a lag
R20 control: a docker.io descriptor installs; each container class gets an application under the copy's names and the class is bound cross-script into agent-worker
R20: each condition in turn leaves the container members out: no Containers scope, an unreadable Containers API, Workers Free, a plan not verified
R20: a descriptor that does not read, a part not named for its class, or a class described twice leaves the member out; an attempted upload that fails is not 'out'
R20: a rollout that keeps the old image is asked once more and then reported as a lag naming the container
R21: a member whose bundle states its limits is uploaded with exactly those; none stated, none sent; an unreadable statement leaves it out and names it
R22: file-scanner is installed with its CAPTURES bucket, its two classes, its schedule from the Worker part, and SECURITY_VPC only as R23 says
R22: a release without the Worker part installs the member without bucket or schedule and the step names what it lacks; a refused schedule is named and the member stays
R23: a good VPC id binds SECURITY_VPC; a refused one installs the member without it and says so; an id with no scanner installed is said; no id, no binding and no note
R24: the upload of agent-worker carries SEGMENTS and CHECKS with both migrations, in order; a script holding v1 gets v2 alone
R37: a member's Durable Objects are those its signed Worker part states and no others: a part stating fewer deploys fewer, and a part stating none deploys none
R25: an instance_type in container.json is passed to the create call and to a rollout; none is created without the field; an unreadable one leaves the member out
R20 (F10): a class a later release adds to an installed container member is created by a migration from the tag it holds; none when it holds every class
R24 (F10): a member's Durable Objects are read from its signed Worker part when it states them; a malformed statement leaves the member out

R6: a lock touched a moment ago stops a second run; one older than the bound does not; the continuing run is not stopped

R16: 503 three times then 200 answers the bytes; 503 for the whole bound throws SourceUnavailable naming what; a 404 throws as a 404; a changed byte throws the integrity error
R17: a signed fleet installs every member, container members first, and answers {done, left, imageLags, completed, containers}

R18: after loadFleet the result holds no Uint8Array, ArrayBuffer or Blob of more than 1 KB anywhere in its graph, and nothing was created
